usages.usage: 在 right now/right away/that is right 中表示「立刻、此刻、沒錯」等口語意思

examples: Um, when it came to going to bed or turning off the lights, I would always run back up the stairs so monsters wouldn't 《get》 me.

breakdowns.sentence: Hello and welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
breakdowns.translation: 大家好，歡迎回到我的慢速英文podcast。

points.label: to 不定詞
points.note: 用來表示目的、補語或接在特定動詞後。

breakdowns.sentence: Um, when it came to going to bed or turning off the lights, I would always run back up the stairs so monsters wouldn't get me.
breakdowns.translation: 嗯，當我要睡覺或關燈時，我總是跑回樓梯上，這樣怪物就不會抓到我了。

points.label: would 表示假設或委婉語氣
points.note: 用來談假設、過去習慣或較委婉的說法。

breakdowns.sentence: And did you have a favorite toy or stuffed animal when you were younger?
breakdowns.translation: 你小時候有最喜歡的玩具或絨毛動物嗎？

points.label: when 時間子句
points.note: 用 when 說明事情發生的時間或情境。

breakdowns.sentence: And that house was a little bigger.

points.label: that 引導名詞子句或關係子句
points.note: that 用來補充說明前面的想法或名詞。

breakdowns.sentence: Oh, I guess that would be another one of my favorite snacks, but now if I eat Flaming Hot Cheetos, my stomach really hurts.
breakdowns.translation: 哦，我想那將是我最喜歡的另一種零食，但現在如果我吃火辣奇多，我的胃真的很痛。

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用 if 帶出條件，再說明在此條件下的結果。

breakdowns.sentence: Doing dishes, taking out the trash every once in a while, and just making sure the house was picked up.
breakdowns.translation: 洗碗，不時倒垃圾，確保房子收拾乾淨。

points.label: while + V-ing / 子句
points.note: 表示兩個動作同時發生。
